book.title: The Lion's Game (John Corey, #2)
book.description:
Detective John Corey, last seen in Plum Island, now faces his toughest assignment yet.
A Libyan terrorist, Asad Khalil, defects, surrendering to American authorities in Paris. The Anti-Terrorist Task Force loses radio contact with the plane bringing him to New York and former cop John Corey has a sense of things rapidly turning wrong. But not even Corey predicted that when the Task Force entered the plane they would find everyone dead and Khalil, a.k.a. the Lion, gone. Corey, with FBI agent Kate Mayfield, sets out to track the Lion, play James Bond, and save the free world.
Filled with unrelenting suspense and surprising plot twists at every terrifying turn, The Lion's Game is a heartstopping race against time and one of Nelson DeMille's most riveting thrillers.
